$comment: Official company data (brief §6 / Phase 6). NOTHING is published until BuyTuk supplies it and an operator flips `published` to true. The UI renders only fields that are non-null AND published — it never invents a placeholder address or phone number.

pendingNote.en: Official email addresses, phone numbers and the registered address are pending client confirmation and are intentionally not published.
pendingNote.ar: البريد الرسمي وأرقام الهاتف والعنوان المسجّل بانتظار تأكيد العميل، ولذلك لا تُنشر عن قصد.
